Subtracting 227 days from 1767-03-04.  
1767 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1767-03-04 back 2 days → 1767-03-02.  
Back 31 days of February (1767-02 has 28 days) → 1767-01-31.  
Remaining days: 227 - 2 - 31 = 194 days earlier into 1766.  
From 1767-01-01 back 194 days: 1766 has 365 days, so 365 - 194 = 171 days into 1766.  
January 31, February 28, March 31, April 30, May 31 → 31+28+31+30+31 = 151 days, leaving 20 days into June → 1766-06-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1766-06-20
